blockers.description: Owner installed app-release-31.1-04.apk on a personal phone and reports that choosing any of the eight backgrounds or None changes the Settings selection but produces no visible background change on other app pages.
blockers.workaround: None. Do not mark Phase 31.1 complete; diagnose and repair before another release gate.

blockers.description: Source inspection identifies a likely render-composition cause: BackgroundHost paints its asset first, then a full-screen colors.surface scrim. SURFACE density opacities are Galaxy 0.88/0.93/0.97 and Standard 0.97/0.99/1.0 (presentation/comfortable/dense), which leaves only 12% or less of Galaxy art and 3%, 1%, or 0% of Standard art visible before opaque component surfaces.
blockers.workaround: Confirm by reproducing on a release-capable device, then design a readable but observably distinct composition consistent with the dossier/owner visual intent.

decisions.decision: Pause Phase 31.1 rather than closing it despite the recorded debug/release UAT pass.
decisions.rationale: The owner’s real-device release report contradicts the acceptance claim and is phase-blocking.

decisions.decision: Do not treat the selector/persistence path as the primary suspected fault yet.
decisions.rationale: Settings updates Zustand immediately and persists the active package column; BackgroundHost consumes the selected store value. The full-screen scrim is the stronger source-backed explanation for imperceptible visuals.

next_action: Read the phase handoff and the canonical dossier/UI spec, reproduce the owner report with a selected contrast-maximizing background in a standalone release, then plan a corrective gap that makes backgrounds visibly observable without weakening readability or the Orrery/Profile exceptions.
context_notes: All four original plans are committed, but the phase is NOT verified or complete. The standalone artifact was delivered to droid Drive and installed on a Pixel. An attempted independent verifier failed only because the agent hit a usage limit; no 31.1-VERIFICATION.md was created.
